from api import call,ROOT
import json,time
P='/projects/project_fixture'
payload={'suiteId':'suite_fixture','serverIds':['server_fixture']}
(ROOT/'run-request.json').write_text(json.dumps(payload,indent=2))
r=call('POST',P+'/eval-runs',payload,'launch')
if not r.get('runId'):
 raise SystemExit('Launch blocked; see launch.json. Retry only after account resolution.')
run=r['runId']
for n in range(20):
 status=call('GET',P+'/eval-runs/'+run,label='status')
 if status.get('status') in ('completed','failed','cancelled','timed_out'):break
 time.sleep(2)
iterations=call('GET',P+'/eval-runs/'+run+'/iterations',label='iterations')
for item in iterations.get('items',[]):
 ident=item.get('id') or item.get('iterationId')
 if ident:call('GET',P+'/eval-runs/'+run+'/iterations/'+ident+'/trace',label='trace-'+ident)
if status.get('result')"'!='"'passed':call('GET',P+'/eval-runs/'+run+'/decision-summary',label='decision-summary')
PY
